## Summary
The telemetry package coordinates LiveKit telemetry collection, analytics delivery, webhook notifications, participant stats aggregation, and network connection metrics. It exposes the main telemetry service contract, no-op implementations, event emission helpers, stats workers, and wrappers that record Prometheus counters for connections and RTP stats.

## Responsibilities
- Define the TelemetryService and AnalyticsService contracts used by room, participant, track, ingress, egress, report, API, webhook, and stats flows.
- Queue webhook notifications and analytics events through a serialized operation queue.
- Track participant stats workers and periodically flush coalesced analytics stats.
- Record Prometheus metrics for participants, tracks, RTP stats, connections, packets, bytes, and signal-adjacent telemetry.
- Provide no-op telemetry and analytics services for disabled telemetry paths.
- Wrap network listeners, stream connections, packet connections, and TURN relay allocation with telemetry counters.
